description: This source file defines an Android RecyclerView.Adapter implementation named AttachmentsRecyclerViewAdapter, which manages and displays a list of URI attachments in a RecyclerView. It includes a nested ViewHolder class, methods for managing the attachment list, and overrides necessary for binding data to views.

classes.name: AttachmentsRecyclerViewAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for managing and displaying a list of URI attachments within a RecyclerView.

methods.name: addAttachment
methods.description: Adds a single Uri attachment to the list.

methods.name: addAttachments
methods.description: Adds a collection of Uri attachments to the list.

methods.name: clearAttachments
methods.description: Clears all attachments from the list.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder by inflating the attachment layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a Uri attachment to the ViewHolder for display.
